scope: Standalone Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 UEFI desktop laboratory installation/recovery disk image plus a separate UEFI-only optical live/installer ISO of the same signed root; not an application installed into existing Ubuntu, a Windows image or a WSL package

source.launch_step_note: The candidate19 freeze, source-test and Rust-test scripts were launched from PowerShell with a preceding wsl.exe sed carriage-return strip. wsl.exe consumed its backslash, so sed removed one trailing 'r' from each line ending in 'r'. In the freeze script this cut the final letter from one comment line ('...and their' became '...and thei') before execution; no command line changed. The source-test and Rust-test scripts had no such line and are byte-identical to what was written. The recorded hashes are of the content as executed. Later launches (assembly, verification, smokes, payload measurement) omit the sed step
source.gwin0_refresh_relation: The committed 2026-10-27 GWIN0 refresh record names the 453ca2e cut. rust/luma-platform/src/staging.rs changed in e29187b, so a GWIN0 package built from this cut or later needs its own refresh record; none was made for sequence 19
